heading: Status of completed addition
lead: Any building constructed under authority of section 71a of this title shall, upon completion, be a part of the National Gallery of Art.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was not enacted as part of act Mar. 24, 1937, ch. 50, 50 Stat. 51, which comprises this subchapter.

ancestors.heading: SMITHSONIAN INSTITUTION, NATIONAL MUSEUMS AND ART GALLERIES
